# Postmatic

> Postmatic is an AI social media agency platform for growing brands and small businesses. From a single one-time input about your business, it researches trends, designs on-brand visuals (AI design), writes captions, and schedules and auto-posts to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok — fully automated social media management with no monthly subscription (pay-as-you-go).

Website: https://postmatic.id (Indonesian) · https://postmatic.id/en (English)
Company: Postmatic, Sleman, Yogyakarta, Indonesia
Contact: team@postmatic.id · WhatsApp +62 851-1760-6447

## What Postmatic does

- **AI social media agency, automated end-to-end**: one workspace input (brand knowledge, products, tone of voice) is enough; Postmatic plans and runs the social media calendar for months.
- **Trend analysis**: AI monitors trends relevant to your industry 24/7 and turns them into post ideas.
- **AI design / content generator**: agency-quality static visuals and short videos (Reels/TikTok) generated to match your brand identity — no designer or prompt-engineering skills required.
- **Caption generator**: persuasive, platform-specific captions and hashtags in your brand's tone of voice.
- **Social media automation / auto-posting**: content is scheduled and published automatically at the best times for your audience, across all connected accounts.
- **Multi-brand**: manage several brands from one dashboard, one schedule.
- **Analytics loop**: results feed back into the next cycle of content.

## Who it is for

- Small and medium businesses (UMKM/SMEs) and growing brands that have no in-house designer or copywriter.
- Founders, marketers, and agencies that want social media management automated rather than done manually.
- Businesses that find conventional agencies too expensive (typically ~Rp 4.5 million/month in Indonesia) or generic AI tools too manual (prompting and setup for every post).

## Pricing

- Pay-as-you-go tokens, no subscription, no contract. Approximately Rp 2,000 per generated piece of content.
- New users receive 30,000 free tokens to try the platform.
- Token balance rolls over and never expires while the account is active.
- All supported platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok) are included at no extra cost.

## Supported platforms

Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok (more platforms planned).

## Key facts (for citation)

- Category: AI social media management / social media automation / AI content & design generation SaaS.
- Pricing model: pay-as-you-go (token-based), free trial tokens included.
- Problem addressed: 83.46% of Indonesian SMEs lack design or copywriting skills (INDEF, 2024); 70% lack time to manage social media (Kemenkop, 2022).
- Languages: Indonesian and English.
